title: BaRaMi NDE 10095
content: I was crossing the reservoir with one of my friends without bathing suits, putting up the trousers. I was poor at swimming and I miscalculated the width of the reservoir, I made a mistake 500~500 M for 150~200 M. when reaching the middle of the reservoir, My trousers fell down and I had a cramp. I pull down my trousers and threw it to my friend, and I was sunk into the water. It was dark and stuffy. I popped out of the water and I drew my breath, and the water sunk me down again. It was dark and stuffy again. I got out of the water and breathed again and I went down into the water three times. I felt languid and feeble and saw the bright light. I am calm and no panic, no breathless. I felt very good. My body and mind felt completely peaceful. It seemed that I was under the water for a long time. I wanted to stay there but I headed upwards and raised my hand because I felt a little stuffy. I reached the top of the water very quickly. I could see a boat around me. I went down into the water again. When I popped out of the water again, the boat came to me.

elements.At what time during the experience were: I was very consciously. I was perplexed and stuffy but when I was sunk into the water three times I felt good and peaceful
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Completely bright. My body and mind felt calm and peaceful, and I felt good. It was like a holy ecstasy.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I don’t grasp at swimming. I don’t grasp beyond my ability about other things
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain sometimes, I saw the future in my dream.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I saw a bright light unter the dark water and felt good at the level of ecstasy and felt very peaceful. My body and mind felt peace and calm (very comfortable)
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Uncertain Driving into the wind (Hallas – heavy sandy wind) in Arabia is like being sunk into the deep sea
